missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Short-form masculine predicate. The short form 'готов' states the current state of 'обед'. Short forms are the usual way to say something is ready.
Strategic focus: Short-form feminine predicate. 'Готова' takes the feminine short-form ending to match a female speaker. The phrase expresses readiness to act.
Strategic focus: Short-form neuter predicate. 'Готово' takes the neuter short-form ending to match 'решение'. The everyday remark anchors the neuter short form.
Strategic focus: Short-form plural predicate. 'Готовы' takes the plural short-form ending to match 'студенты'. The short form with 'к' expresses readiness for something.
Strategic focus: Masculine accusative full form. 'Готовый' matches the inanimate masculine 'суп', whose accusative looks like the nominative. The full form labels a product as ready-made.
Strategic focus: Feminine accusative full form. 'Готовую' takes the feminine accusative ending to match 'пиццу'. The full form describes a ready-made item.
Strategic focus: Neuter nominative full form. 'Готовое' takes the neuter ending to match 'блюдо'. The full form acts as a regular attribute of the noun.

missions.phrase: Он готов помочь в любую минуту.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Short-form masculine predicate. 'Готов' states the subject's willingness to act. The short form is standard for expressing readiness to do something.
Strategic focus: Short-form plural predicate with future. After 'будут', 'готовы' takes the plural short-form ending to match 'документы'. The pattern projects readiness into the future.
Strategic focus: Short-form feminine predicate in the past. After 'была', 'готова' keeps the feminine short form to match the subject. The короткая форма is the natural choice for readiness.
